csv_scope_of_work: The City of St. Cloud is seeking professional services quotes for a bridge rehabilitation design for the University Bridge (Bridge No 73540) in the City of St. Cloud. The professional services will include the development of plans and specifications signed by a structural engineer licensed in the State of Minnesota to address critical findings, and other notable issues that were documented during the most recent inspection. The services shall address at a minimum: 1. Replacement of all expansion joints/glands to provide waterproofing to slow deterioration of the lower components of the pier tables. 2. Rehabilitation of the bridge seat and bearings at Piers 6 and 7.
